name: Banking & Financial Services
headlineSummary: The cornerstone of South Africa’s sophisticated capital markets, governed by the Twin Peaks model and navigating international anti-money laundering (FATF) remediation.
gdpSource: Stats SA GDP P0441 (Finance, Real Estate & Business Services)
keyLegislation: Financial Sector Regulation Act (FSRA) 9 of 2017 (Twin Peaks)
Financial Intelligence Centre Act (FICA) (Amended 2022 for FATF compliance)

policyIssues.summary: Addressing the 22 action items designated by the Financial Action Task Force in February 2023, specifically beneficial ownership registers and prosecuting complex financial crimes.
policyIssues.stakeholders: National Treasury, FIC, NPA, Commercial Banks (BASA)

policyIssues.summary: Enacted in September 2024, enabling split retirement savings into savings and vested pots. Liquidity outflows from retirement funds required careful asset-liability management by domestic banks and asset managers.

policyIssues.topic: Fintech, Open Banking & Payment System Modernization
policyIssues.summary: Implementation of the SARB National Payment System Framework (Vision 2025), PayShap real-time clearing, and regulatory sandboxing of stablecoins and crypto assets.
policyIssues.stakeholders: SARB FinTech Unit, Payment Association of SA (PASA), Challenger Banks

name: Mining & Critical Resources
headlineSummary: Historical industrial foundation endowed with world-leading platinum group metals (PGMs), manganese, and chrome reserves, but constrained by Transnet rail/port bottlenecks and the global energy transition.
gdpSource: Stats SA GDP P0441 (Mining and Quarrying)
keyRegulators: Department of Mineral and Petroleum Resources (DMPR)
Department of Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment (DFFE)
keyLegislation: Mineral and Petroleum Resources Development Act (MPRDA) 28 of 2002
Mining Charter III (and associated High Court rulings on "once empowered, always empowered")

policyIssues.summary: Inability to move coal on the Richards Bay Coal Terminal corridor and iron ore/manganese on the Saldanha line has resulted in an estimated R50bn+ in foregone export tax receipts and curtailed capital expenditure.
policyIssues.stakeholders: Transnet, Minerals Council South Africa, National Logistics Crisis Committee (NLCC)

policyIssues.summary: Migration from the dysfunctional SAMRAD licensing system to an auditable, transparent modern cadastral management software system to resolve thousands of backlog exploration licenses.
policyIssues.stakeholders: DMPR, Council for Geoscience, Junior Miners

policyIssues.topic: Just Energy Transition & PGM Demand Shifts
policyIssues.summary: Global transition to battery electric vehicles (BEVs) threatens long-term demand for internal combustion catalytic converters (PGMs: platinum, palladium, rhodium), necessitating investments in green hydrogen.
policyIssues.stakeholders: Presidential Climate Commission (PCC), Eskom, Mining Unions (NUM, AMCU)

officialPublications.title: Mining Production and Sales (Statistical Release P2041)

name: Retail & Consumer Goods (FMCG)
headlineSummary: High-volume consumer facing trade exposed directly to household real disposable income pressures, food inflation dynamics, and intense regulatory oversight by the Competition Commission.
formalEmployment: ~3.2 million workers across wholesale, retail and hospitality
gdpSource: Stats SA GDP P0441 (Wholesale, retail & motor trade)
keyRegulators: Department of Trade, Industry and Competition (DTIC)

policyIssues.topic: Essential Food Pricing Inquiries & Margin Scrutiny
policyIssues.summary: The Competition Commission actively monitors the "rocket-and-feather" phenomenon—where retail prices surge rapidly when input costs rise (sunflower oil, poultry, maize) but decrease sluggishly when farmgate prices normalize.
policyIssues.stakeholders: Competition Commission, Grocery Retailers (Shoprite, Pick n Pay, Woolworths, Spar), Consumer Groups

policyIssues.topic: Shein & Temu De Minimis Tax Equalization
policyIssues.summary: SARS and DTIC closed the 20% flat customs loophole for low-value e-commerce parcels under R500, aligning offshore platforms with the standard 45% ad valorem clothing tariff plus VAT to protect domestic textile manufacturers.
policyIssues.stakeholders: SARS, DTIC, National Clothing Retail Federation (NCRF), SACTWU

policyIssues.summary: Cumulative interest rate hikes between 2021 and 2023 pushed household debt-service ratios to nearly 9% of disposable income, capping discretionary retail expansion and shifting consumer baskets toward value staples.
policyIssues.stakeholders: SARB, Commercial Lenders, Retail Credit Providers

name: ICT & Telecommunications
headlineSummary: Dynamic digital backbone driving financial inclusion, mobile commerce, and cloud infrastructure, operating under intensive spectrum policy debates and municipal rights-of-way battles.
gdpSource: Stats SA GDP P0441 (Transport, storage & communication)
keyRegulators: Independent Communications Authority of South Africa (ICASA)
Department of Communications and Digital Technologies (DCDT)
keyLegislation: Protection of Personal Information Act (POPIA) 4 of 2013

policyIssues.summary: Following the watershed 2022 spectrum auction which raised R14.4bn for the fiscus, ICASA is preparing secondary sub-1GHz and 3.5GHz-10GHz spectrum allocations to accelerate rural 5G access and shut down legacy 2G/3G networks.
policyIssues.stakeholders: ICASA, Vodacom, MTN, Telkom, Rain, Liquid Intelligent Technologies

policyIssues.topic: Competition Commission Data Services Market Inquiries
policyIssues.summary: Enforcement of data pricing reductions, compulsory free monthly lifelines of data for indigent users, and zero-rating of educational and government domains.
policyIssues.stakeholders: Competition Commission, Mobile Network Operators (MNOs), Civil Society

policyIssues.summary: Network availability threatened by chronic battery theft and diesel theft at base stations during power outages, alongside bureaucratic delays in municipal rapid-deployment guidelines.
policyIssues.stakeholders: SAPS, Critical Infrastructure Protection Council, SALGA

officialPublications.title: State of ICT Sector in South Africa Report
Next Generation Spectrum Policy for South Africa
officialPublications.publisher: Department of Communications and Digital Technologies
